adaptations: Same 2x128 MLP, Adam, eight epochs / minimum 2000 steps per task as the registered neural comparison.
A single class-balanced multiclass CE on concatenated stream and inverse-local-count replay; native binary BCE is not used.
Each current-task presentation is a stream encounter, including epoch repeats; replay is not re-counted or re-admitted.
Budget grows to 200 times seen classes including Normal; old discarded examples are never replenished.
Raw-count softmax gamma follows the printed equation; illustrative gamma=262 is not claimed reproduced.
identity.author_difference: Author memory_update uses minority_allocation and different full/victim/retrieval rules; the completed UNSW author-rule sensitivity is separate and is not executed here.

effective_config.derpp_allocation_adaptation: Classwise reservoir at 200/class replaces official global reservoir; objective and two independent memory minibatches retained; shared class-balanced CE and Adam/MLP protocol
effective_config.derpp_coefficient_source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aimagelab/mammoth/e75a491c69fd729edeb01431afb753d9157d9a81/models/config/derpp.yaml (seq-cifar100, buffer500); transferred fixed coefficients, not NIDS-tuned

identity.entry_adaptation: NSL portable dataset extension; unchanged registered multiclass training and paper-memory loop.
identity.implementation_scope: Paper Algorithm 1 and literal Equation 1 memory, adapted to the registered multiclass protocol; not author-code execution or exact native binary reproduction.

memory_semantics.full: persistent union of local-count maxima after every stream arrival
memory_semantics.native_task: binary supervised NIDS; this class stores original family labels only
memory_semantics.retrieval: inverse local class count per stored item, without replacement
memory_semantics.victim: largest global encounter count among nonempty gamma-eligible classes; class-ID tie

delivery.note: NSL-KDD unregistered extension; ecbrs=paper-memory adaptation, bic=common-budget flow CNN; ar=neural AR, not R3-A stateless.
delivery.runtime_version_evidence: Same installed runtime inspected after execution; pinned job environment and entry overlay preserved. Not an original per-cell host telemetry sample.
